messages:
nina-marketing: Drafted the launch blog copy — link in the draft folder. Main asks: legal quick-pass on claims, two CTA variants for hero, and HubSpot form mapping for webinar registrants. Prefer publish slot tomorrow 9:30am PT.

sam-growth: Nice. For CTAs I recommend: [Register for Live Demo] and [Try Hosted API]. Will set UTMs: utm_source=launch_blog&utm_campaign=may_launch&utm_content=register|try.

leo-product: On benchmarks: we should qualify as 'internal benchmark' and include a short methodology note. Proposal: "In our internal benchmark on p4d (batch=4) Redwood reduced per-token cost by up to 2.3x vs baseline." Attaching perf snippet in the doc.

kevin-legal: Please avoid absolutes. "up to 2.3x" is okay if footnoted with methodology link. Don't use "game-changing" or "industry-leading". Add the drive link and the exact test config. Once that's in, I can sign off quickly.

marie-design: Two hero options uploaded to the draft: variant A (photo + stacked CTAs) and B (illustration + single CTA with subtle secondary). I also exported social banners 1200x628 / 800x800 / 1080x1080. Which CTA copy to wire?

nina-marketing: We'll wire both: hero primary = Register for Live Demo, secondary = Try Hosted API. Social uses 'Try Redwood' short CTA. Also need the small badge for "SLA-backed latency" callout — Marie, can you produce a 72x24 badge?

marie-design: Yep, badge in assets/ badges/latency-sla-72x24.png.

hubspot-bot: Form mapping suggestion: use existing form id 9f2c7a, map hidden fields: source=launch_blog, campaign=may_launch, webinar_tier=early_access. Optionally set list membership: add to list "Launch Webinar - Registrants".

sam-growth: I'll configure the hidden fields and add a webhook to post to #sales-inbound on submit. Also add a conditional tag if "webinar_tier=early_access" to trigger priority nudges.

nina-marketing: Publish preview requested. @publish-bot can we get a staging URL?

publish-bot: Staging preview created: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/4290001111. Snapshot saved at 4290001234.

leo-product: Quick content tweak request: the section that says "support for private deployments" should mention VPC and on-prem briefly. Can we add one sentence?

nina-marketing: Added one-liner. Also inserted the drive methodology link and reworded benchmarks to legal's suggestion: "in our internal benchmark (p4d, batch=4), Redwood reduced per-token inference cost by up to 2.3x compared to the baseline model. See methodology."

kevin-legal: Confirmed. I reviewed the drive doc and approve numeric claim with that exact phrasing and link.

marie-design: Social banners uploaded to the CMS. I left file names with utm tags in the draft folder for easy publish.

sam-growth: HubSpot mapping done and webhook added. Tested form → #sales-inbound. Sample payload looks good.

nina-marketing: Awesome. Final checklist before publish: 1) legal approval (done) 2) design assets uploaded (done) 3) form mapping + webhook (done) 4) staging preview looks correct (please sanity check) 5) schedule social posts. I plan to hit publish tomorrow 9:30am PT unless anyone raises an issue by EOD.

sam-growth: all green from growth. :rocket: 

kevin-legal: approved.

leo-product: LGTM.

marie-design: All assets ready.

nina-marketing: Thanks team — locking copy at 5:00pm PT. Will post final publish notice in #launch-coordination when live.
